name: Recovery Code Sign-In Succeeds
summary: An identified returning user submits one valid unused TOTP recovery code, the code is consumed exactly once, and the server establishes a normal authenticated application session.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active durable identity with confirmed email, enabled TOTP, recovery codes, and an outstanding MFA requirement is prepared for sign-in

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Previously identified durable-user email held by the authentication flow.

inputs.name: Recovery Code
inputs.description: One unused recovery code generated during TOTP enrollment or recovery-code rotation.

serverInteraction.intent: Resolve the existing durable identity, consume exactly one valid recovery code, satisfy the outstanding MFA requirement, establish the application session, and resolve the landing destination.

postconditions.expression: the submitted recovery code is consumed, TOTP remains enabled for the durable identity, and an authenticated application session is active

sourceReferences.note: ConsumeRecoveryCodeAsync validates the stored recovery-code set and consumes one accepted code.
The current recovery-code endpoint is confirmed-current-user only and does not yet establish an anonymous post-password application session.
